digest.component_or_area: store write lock and compaction sweep labeling
propositions: A blocked writer cannot identify whether a lock holder is a compaction sweep or determine if interrupting it is safe, receiving only a bare pid in the LockTimeout message
Compaction sweeps are interruptible and safely restartable since skipped sweeps are no-ops and events remain live for the next trigger to fold
Lock holder information must be added ambiently via a contextvars-based operation label that propagates through the acquisition path without editing compact_txn.py
The lock owner stamp must include an optional colon-free op= field that persists through the v2 format and reaches describe_lock_holder and LockTimeout error messages
LockTimeout errors for known interruptible operations must include remedial guidance stating that the holder is a compaction sweep, interruption loses no data, and the next trigger will refold
